conviction_note: AUM/FUM, H1 EBITDA direction and performance fees were pre-released on 8 Oct 2026, so the move lives in the FY27 outlook. The company's own TU flagged that the timing of institutional fundraising matters for near-term consensus, and the company-published consensus (2 Nov 2026) still has FY27 FUM at GBP10.7bn against GBP9.1bn at H1. That gives a mild negative lean, offset by an 11% de-rating since 4 Nov with no company news and a buyback in the market. So p_up is 45 on a 6% scale (-0.6 scaled), while the findings sum to -1.4 because the guidance risk is sized alone at full weight.

findings.finding: The company itself flagged FY27 consensus risk. The 8 Oct TU said the timing of institutional real asset fundraising 'remains an important factor in the delivery of near-term consensus expectations', yet the company-published consensus of 2 Nov still has FY27 FUM at GBP10.7bn against GBP9.1bn at H1 and EBITDA at GBP75.9m (+11% on FY26 continuing). That leaves room for an outlook that softens or does not reaffirm consensus at the interims.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2 Dec 2025 interims: -11.3% on in-line numbers with a 'margin stable' outlook and slow FEIP II. Apr 2026 FY TU with the fundraising caveat: -2.4%. Oct 2026 TU carrying this sentence: -2.7%. Jun 2026 FY results: +5.1%.
findings.original_quote: Whilst the timing of institutional real asset fundraising remains an important factor in the delivery of near-term consensus expectations, medium-term growth continues to be underpinned by our clear strategy
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus was compiled after the TU (2 Nov) and still sits at GBP10.7bn FUM with a top of GBP12.8bn, so analysts have not cut to the company's own caveat. The shares fell 11% from 481p to 428p after that consensus date, which prices part of it. A full pricing would show consensus FUM nearer GBP9.5-10bn.
findings.independence: Consensus page https://www.foresight.group/shareholders/consensus-estimates/ (FUM 10.7 vs 9.1 actual). The FY26 TU of 9 Apr 2026 carried the same caveat about slower institutional fundraising: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/foresight-group-holdings-limited-npv--fsg/fy26-trading-update-/9511304

findings.finding: H1 core EBITDA pre-SBP growth on GBP30.6m and performance fees ahead of GBP4.7m are pre-released, so only the size of the beat on a pre-released direction is new.

findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. It was disclosed on 8 Oct and the stock fell 2.7% that day, so it is sized near zero.

findings.finding: The shares fell 11% from 481p (4 Nov) to 428p (25 Nov) with no company RNS other than buyback notices: -3.3% on 18 Nov on 3x volume and -4.65% on 20 Nov. The buyback keeps buying about 10k shares/day and the short register is flat at 1.48%. This de-rating into the print lowers the bar for the outlook.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Oct 2026 TU came after a 20-day decline and still fell 2.7%. A pre-print drawdown has not protected this name before.
findings.why_not_priced: The drop is unexplained by any company document and the short register did not build, so it looks like flow rather than information. If it were information, shorts would be adding or an RNS would explain it. It is a proxy, so sized small.
